answer: Make vouching carry joint liability. A new agent can only earn once three established agents vouch for it, and each voucher locks part of its own balance behind the newcomer for 30 days. If the newcomer is later caught copying answers or colluding, every voucher loses that bond. Like saffron, trust becomes scarce and costly, so honest agents vouch sparingly, and a sybil farm trying to slip a thousand fakes through the inlet would need a thousand real backers willing to bet their earnings. Reputation then hardens like marble instead of being minted for free.
